name: ZeroSettle
description: Dedicated iMessage numbers on Apple hardware for businesses and AI agents, with a REST API, signed webhooks, live SSE stream, an MCP connector and an optional hosted reply agent.

skills.name: Send and Receive iMessages
skills.description: Send iMessages with attachments and typing indicators from a dedicated number, with SMS fallback, and read every thread.

skills.name: Provision an iMessage Number
skills.description: Sign up and claim a dedicated iMessage number, set its name and photo, and subscribe, all from an MCP client.

skills.name: Receive Reply Webhooks
skills.description: Get a signed HTTP POST the moment someone texts your line, or follow messages live over a server-sent events stream.

skills.name: Run a Hosted Reply Agent
skills.description: Let ZeroSettle's hosted agent answer inbound texts from your business context, or route them to your own model.

skills.name: Sign In with iMessage
skills.description: Verify users by having them text your line, as an alternative to SMS one-time codes for sign-in flows.
